newsitem.title: USA: Arch well tests at 1,100 bbls/day.
newsitem.headline: Arch well tests at 1,100 bbls/day.

text.p: Arch Petroleum Inc said on Tuesday that its PC Garrington 4-8 well in Alberta, Canada that is operated by Petro-Canada, has flow tested at 1,100 barrels of oil and 3.0 million cubic feet of natural gas per day.
The well flowed from 278 feet of Leduc Reef pay, the company said.
Arch said it owns 25 percent working interest in the 11,500 foot well.
The well is scheduled to begin production in the second quarter of 1997, Arch said.

An offset to this well, the PC Trax Garrington 10-7, also operated by Petro-Canada, has reached total depth in the Leduc Reef, has logged 239 feet of pay, and production casing has been run, the company said.
Arch, which owns a 12.5 percent working interest in this well, anticipates that production from this well will also begin in the second quarter.
